svg.aria-label: How many Puy-de-Dôme communes each PDO cheese covers. For milk and cheese-making, the Fourme d'Ambert area is the largest, 292 communes; the Saint-Nectaire production zone has 49.
svg.title: How many Puy-de-Dôme communes each PDO cheese covers
svg.desc: For milk and cheese-making, the Fourme d'Ambert area is the largest, 292 communes; the Saint-Nectaire production zone has 49. Unit: communes. Option: milk production and cheese-making; only Saint-Nectaire changes, its production zone covers 49 communes of the département instead of 463; the other five appellations have a single area. Perimeter: the 463 communes of Puy-de-Dôme in the 2025 official geographic code; 7 former codes of the INAO list counted in their current commune, which is already listed; Sayat, partly within the Cantal and Salers area, counted whole. Sources: French National Institute of Origin and Quality (INAO), list of communes in AOC and PDO areas (2025-10-09); INAO, AOC, PDO and PGI areas and products (2025-03-10); INAO, register of products under an official quality and origin label (2025-12-31); INAO, specification of the Saint-Nectaire appellation, approved version (2025-11-06); IGN, ADMIN EXPRESS commune boundaries (2025); Insee, official geographic code (2025).
